items.source: Create a new MapAccessor for reading as well as writing.
items.translation: 创建一个新的用于读写操作的MapAccessor。

items.source: Create a new MapAccessor for reading and possibly also writing.
items.translation: 创建一个新的MapAccessor用于读取，可能也用于写入。

items.source: allowWrite - whether to allow write operations on a target instance
items.translation: allowWrite - 是否允许对目标实例执行写入操作

items.source: SpEL PropertyAccessor that knows how to access the keys of a standard Map.
items.translation: SpEL 一个知道如何访问标准 Map 键的PropertyAccessor。

items.source: as of Spring Framework 7.0 in favor of MapAccessor.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，转而使用MapAccessor。
